On Thursday, a baby died from hypothermia in Gaza. He was 9 months old. His
name was Kinan Ahmed Raqiq.

Just four days earlier, at least three children were killed when a sand dune
collapsed on their tent amid heavy rain, strong winds, and severe flooding.

Make no mistake: These children are dead because of Israel's genocidal
actions. Its continued bombing has repeatedly displaced Palestinians, forcing
them to move to cramped, unsafe areas. Israel continues to heavily restrict
what aid and supplies enter Gaza, forcing Palestinians to contend with
inadequate shelters - shelters that flood, let in cold air, and collapse.
